entities.summary: Min Aung Hlaing is a Burmese politician, retired army general, and the president-elect of Myanmar, having ruled the country under various titles since seizing power in the 2021 coup d'état. He led the Tatmadaw as Commander-in-Chief of Defence Services from 2011 to 2026. Following the coup, he served as Chairman of the State Administration Council from 2021 to 2026 and as the 12th prime minister from 2021 to 2025. He also exercised presidential duties from 2024, served as acting president from 2025 to 2026, and was chairman of the State Security and Peace Commission from 2025 to 2026.
